title: Understanding Distortion in k-Means
text: In k-Means clustering, distortion refers to the sum of squared distances between each data point and its assigned cluster center. Think about how the initial placement of cluster centers might affect this distortion.

title: Convergence in k-Means
text: Consider how k-Means clustering updates cluster centers iteratively. What role does the initial configuration play in reaching the minimum distortion?

title: Evaluating Convergence
text: Which of the following statements is true about k-Means clustering convergence?
choices: Convergence always reaches the true minimum
Convergence is guaranteed to be optimal
Convergence is independent of initial configuration
